title: ADR-034 Domain Map Approval Record
description: Durable, mechanically checkable approval record for the ADR-035 bounded-domain map. Required only for plans declaring domain_boundaries_changed: true; the record binds the approved map file to its SHA-256 so dispatch validation can detect tampering or drift.

map_path.description: Repository-relative path to the approved domain map file.

map_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the approved map file contents.

approved_by.description: Identifier of the human approver (e.g., kyler).
